scope: Batch 2 Phase 3 (Milestones G and H): customer-owned Supabase (project selection, reviewed schema with RLS, approved migration), customer-owned Vercel (unlinked preview, read-only remote QA, separately approved production), revision provenance, stranded-operation recovery, golden acceptance tests A to J and the twelve-target matrix. Disabled by default; nothing is applied, deployed or enabled and no external account was touched.

keep: Canonical scheduler, tryUniversalBuild, SoftwareAgent/Cline, live-preview coordinator and project runtime
Existing vault-held Supabase and Vercel tokens and the Phase 2 approval lifecycle
Phase 1 and Phase 2 durable projects, revisions, QA and GitHub export
extend: builder_external_operations widened to Supabase and Vercel operations through the shared OperationRunner
QA plan gains a read-only mode and the QA driver gains extra request headers for remote verification
replace: Starter materialization no longer re-detects the scaffold kind from prompt text

schemaImpact.rollout: Additive: widens two CHECK constraints on builder_external_operations. Depends on the Phase 2 migration. Not applied by this change; apply through the verified migration workflow after review.
schemaImpact.rollback: Delete rows whose provider is not github, then restore the narrower provider and action CHECK constraints (documented in the migration and exercised on real PostgreSQL in CI).

auth.description: New Phase 3 routes require the issued tenant context; every project and operation id is resolved against the verified owner and a foreign id returns 404.

tenant.description: No new tables. Operations reuse the owner-scoped Phase 2 table; the new routes and services filter by the verified owner.

approval.description: Every Supabase and Vercel change goes prepare, approve (quoting the plan digest, expiring) and execute with a database-arbitrated single in-flight operation per provider. Production additionally needs a succeeded preview with passed remote tests, a separate plan and a typed confirmation.

credentials.description: Provider tokens are read only from the existing vault at execution time and never stored in plans, receipts, logs or responses. The Supabase service-role key is never requested; apps receive only the public URL and publishable key; privileged environment values are refused by name and by value.

egress.description: Remote QA is read-only and restricted to the deployed application origin; protection headers are sent only to that origin.

cost.description: No billable resource is created without an approved plan that states the cost responsibility. Vercel deployments run in the customer account.

billing.description: No payment or subscription path changes.

tests.scope: Schema derivation and review, project selection, approval, migration, reconciliation, environment guard, adapter contract.
Vercel preview, remote verification, production gating, wrong team, revoked connection, lost responses, adapter contract.
Golden groups A to J against the production services.
HTTP layer: identity required, cross-tenant 404, full delivery flow, no credentials in responses.
Generated schemas against real PostgreSQL (RLS, isolation, double-booking), Phase 3 migration and rollback, stranded-operation slot release.

architecture.reason: Adds customer-owned Supabase and Vercel operations around the existing builder projects through the same approval lifecycle. No scheduler, runtime, browser stack, agent framework or authentication system is added.

rollout: Merge only after review and your authorization. Then apply the builder migrations, enable the canonical engine for builder projects, deploy to the Google runtime and set NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_BUILDER=1, each as a separate approved step. Provider live tests need approved disposable accounts.
rollback: Disable NEXT_PUBLIC_XROGA_BUILDER; routes are inert without a project. Restore the narrower constraints with the statements above.
knownGaps: No live Supabase project, Vercel deployment or GitHub repository test: they need approved disposable accounts
No generated application has been run on the Google runtime: it needs PR #856 and the enabled canonical engine
Remote QA of a deployment-protected preview needs a protection-bypass secret Xroga does not yet store
Vercel does not document disabling Git deployments, so Git-linked projects are refused and only unlinked projects are used
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Live provider behaviour (Supabase, Vercel, GitHub) is unverified
Deployed full-stack behaviour (application plus database in the published environment) is unverified

blockers: Migrations not applied and canonical engine not enabled
No approved Supabase, Vercel or GitHub test accounts for live provider verification
Authenticated end-to-end and staged security proof not run for this change
